title: Listening Drill — Map-reading workshop — Briefing
description: Session briefing. One synthetic recording, six questions. Recommended time: 7 minutes.

sections.title: Map-reading workshop — Briefing
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: This is a message for everyone joining the session on map-reading workshop. Please disregard the date on the original notice: it showed Thursday. The group will now meet on Friday, following a change to the staff timetable.

ORGANISER: Please wait by the stone arch; we will enter together. Feel free to come ten minutes early, but please do not go straight to the working area. The one thing you should bring yourself is small compass. Everything else will be provided.

ORGANISER: Allow fifteen minutes for the group activity, plus extra time if you have a question. We will start by showing you how to check map orientation before anyone has a go independently.

ORGANISER: You can watch the demonstration a second time if anything is unclear. Before leaving, please give us your completed marked map so we can offer feedback.
